description: This file defines the 'ThingEvent' interface in Java, which serves as the base for all Thing-related event classes in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes nested static class 'JsonFields' defining JSON field constants used in serialization and deserialization of Thing events.

classes.name: ThingEvent
classes.description: An interface representing all events related to a 'Thing' in the Eclipse Ditto system. It extends other event and 'WithThingId' interfaces, providing common constants and default method implementations for 'Thing' events.

classes.name: ThingEvent.JsonFields
classes.description: A final static inner class containing JSON field definitions (constants) for the 'thingId', 'featureId', and 'thing' JSON fields used in serialization/deserialization of 'ThingEvent' objects.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the 'ThingId' associated with the event.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type string, which is 'thing'.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the DittoHeaders for this event object and returns the modified object.
